measures.name: Revenue PY
measures.expression:
VAR d = [Latest Reporting Period]
RETURN CALCULATE ( SUM ( MART_COMPANY_PERFORMANCE[REVENUE] ), MART_COMPANY_PERFORMANCE[PERIOD_END] = EOMONTH ( d, -12 ) )

measures.name: Net Income PY
measures.expression:
VAR d = [Latest Reporting Period]
RETURN CALCULATE ( SUM ( MART_COMPANY_PERFORMANCE[NET_INCOME] ), MART_COMPANY_PERFORMANCE[PERIOD_END] = EOMONTH ( d, -12 ) )

measures.name: Operating Income PY
measures.expression:
VAR d = [Latest Reporting Period]
RETURN CALCULATE ( SUM ( MART_COMPANY_PERFORMANCE[OPERATING_INCOME] ), MART_COMPANY_PERFORMANCE[PERIOD_END] = EOMONTH ( d, -12 ) )

measures.name: Operating Margin PY
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Operating Income PY], [Revenue PY] )

measures.name: Revenue YoY %
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Latest Period Revenue] - [Revenue PY], [Revenue PY] )

measures.name: Net Income YoY %
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Latest Period Net Income] - [Net Income PY], [Net Income PY] )

measures.name: Operating Income YoY %
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Latest Period Operating Income] - [Operating Income PY], [Operating Income PY] )

measures.name: Operating Margin YoY pp
measures.expression:
VAR p = [Operating Margin PY]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( p ), BLANK (), [Latest Operating Margin] - p )

measures.name: Operating Cash Flow Latest
measures.expression: CALCULATE ( SUM ( MART_COMPANY_PERFORMANCE[OPERATING_CASH_FLOW] ), MART_COMPANY_PERFORMANCE[PERIOD_END] = [Latest Reporting Period] )

measures.name: KPI Revenue Text
measures.expression: IF ( ISBLANK ( [Latest Period Revenue] ), "–", "$" & FORMAT ( [Latest Period Revenue] / 1000000000, "#,##0.00" ) & "B" )

measures.name: KPI Net Income Text
measures.expression: IF ( ISBLANK ( [Latest Period Net Income] ), "–", "$" & FORMAT ( [Latest Period Net Income] / 1000000000, "#,##0.00" ) & "B" )

measures.name: KPI Operating Income Text
measures.expression: IF ( ISBLANK ( [Latest Period Operating Income] ), "–", "$" & FORMAT ( [Latest Period Operating Income] / 1000000000, "#,##0.00" ) & "B" )

measures.name: KPI Operating Margin Text
measures.expression: IF ( ISBLANK ( [Latest Operating Margin] ), "–", FORMAT ( [Latest Operating Margin], "0.00%" ) )

measures.name: KPI OCF Text
measures.expression: IF ( ISBLANK ( [Operating Cash Flow Latest] ), "–", "$" & FORMAT ( [Operating Cash Flow Latest] / 1000000000, "#,##0.0" ) & "B" )

measures.name: KPI Revenue YoY Text
measures.expression: IF ( ISBLANK ( [Revenue YoY %] ), "–", FORMAT ( [Revenue YoY %], "0.00%" ) )

measures.name: KPI Net Income YoY Text
measures.expression: IF ( ISBLANK ( [Net Income YoY %] ), "–", FORMAT ( [Net Income YoY %], "0.00%" ) )

measures.name: Revenue YoY Label
measures.expression:
VAR x = [Revenue YoY %]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( x ), "–", IF ( x >= 0, "▲ +", "▼ " ) & FORMAT ( x, "0.00%" ) & " YoY" )

measures.name: Net Income YoY Label
measures.expression:
VAR x = [Net Income YoY %]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( x ), "–", IF ( x >= 0, "▲ +", "▼ " ) & FORMAT ( x, "0.00%" ) & " YoY" )

measures.name: Operating Income YoY Label
measures.expression:
VAR x = [Operating Income YoY %]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( x ), "–", IF ( x >= 0, "▲ +", "▼ " ) & FORMAT ( x, "0.00%" ) & " YoY" )

measures.name: Operating Margin YoY Label
measures.expression:
VAR x = [Operating Margin YoY pp]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( x ), "–", IF ( x >= 0, "▲ +", "▼ " ) & FORMAT ( x * 100, "0.00" ) & " pp YoY" )

measures.name: Revenue YoY Color
measures.expression: IF ( [Revenue YoY %] >= 0, "#16A34A", "#DC2626" )

measures.name: Net Income YoY Color
measures.expression: IF ( [Net Income YoY %] >= 0, "#16A34A", "#DC2626" )

measures.name: Operating Income YoY Color
measures.expression: IF ( [Operating Income YoY %] >= 0, "#16A34A", "#DC2626" )

measures.name: Operating Margin YoY Color
measures.expression: IF ( [Operating Margin YoY pp] >= 0, "#16A34A", "#DC2626" )

measures.name: As Of Text
measures.expression: FORMAT ( [Latest Reporting Period], "yyyy-mm-dd" )

measures.name: Insight Revenue
measures.expression:
VAR d = [Latest Reporting Period]
VAR q = "Q" & ROUNDUP ( MONTH ( d ) / 3, 0 ) & " " & YEAR ( d )
VAR x = [Revenue YoY %]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( x ), "–", "Revenue " & IF ( x >= 0, "grew ", "fell " ) & FORMAT ( ABS ( x ), "0.00%" ) & " YoY to $" & FORMAT ( [Latest Period Revenue] / 1000000000, "#,##0.00" ) & "B (" & q & ")" )

measures.name: Insight Net Income
measures.expression:
VAR x = [Net Income YoY %]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( x ), "–", "Net income " & IF ( x >= 0, "up ", "down " ) & FORMAT ( ABS ( x ), "0.00%" ) & " YoY to $" & FORMAT ( [Latest Period Net Income] / 1000000000, "#,##0.00" ) & "B" )

measures.name: Insight Margin
measures.expression:
VAR x = [Operating Margin YoY pp]
RETURN IF ( ISBLANK ( x ), "Operating margin " & FORMAT ( [Latest Operating Margin], "0.00%" ),
    "Operating margin " & IF ( x >= 0, "improved", "contracted" ) & " to " & FORMAT ( [Latest Operating Margin], "0.00%" ) )

measures.name: Quarter Complete
measures.expression: DISTINCTCOUNT ( MART_COMPANY_PERFORMANCE[COMPANY_NAME] ) = CALCULATE ( DISTINCTCOUNT ( MART_COMPANY_PERFORMANCE[COMPANY_NAME] ), REMOVEFILTERS ( MART_COMPANY_PERFORMANCE[PERIOD_END] ) )

measures.name: Trend Revenue
measures.expression: IF ( [Quarter Complete], SUM ( MART_COMPANY_PERFORMANCE[REVENUE] ) )

measures.name: Trend Net Income
measures.expression: IF ( [Quarter Complete], SUM ( MART_COMPANY_PERFORMANCE[NET_INCOME] ) )

measures.name: Trend Operating Income
measures.expression: IF ( [Quarter Complete], SUM ( MART_COMPANY_PERFORMANCE[OPERATING_INCOME] ) )

measures.name: Trend Operating Margin
measures.expression: DIVIDE ( [Trend Operating Income], [Trend Revenue] )
